language.machineNote: This translation was made with AI and hasn't been reviewed by a native speaker yet. Recovery scales stay in English until validated translations are available.
mobile.about.disclaimer: Quit Journey supports your recovery; it isn't medical advice or treatment. Recovery timelines summarise public-health guidance (WHO, CDC, NHS, NIAAA, NIDA, SAMHSA) and the studies named on each timeline.
mobile.about.heading: About
mobile.about.medical: Talk to a doctor or pharmacist about medication, and never stop alcohol or benzodiazepines suddenly after heavy use without medical advice. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
mobile.backup.confirmRestore: Restore "{name}" ({cravings, plural, one {# craving} other {# cravings}}, {checkIns, plural, one {# check-in} other {# check-ins}})? If this journey is already on the phone, the backup replaces it.
mobile.backup.heading: Backup
mobile.backup.intro: Your journeys are stored only on this phone. Save a backup of this journey to Drive, email or anywhere you like. Restoring a backup brings it back next to your other journeys.
mobile.backup.notBackup: That file isn't a Quit Journey backup.
mobile.backup.notJson: That file isn't a Quit Journey backup (it isn't valid JSON).
mobile.delete.heading: Delete this journey
mobile.delete.intro: Removes "{name}" and everything logged in it from this phone. Save a backup first if you might want it back.
mobile.delete.introOthers: Removes "{name}" and everything logged in it from this phone; your other journeys stay. Save a backup first if you might want it back.
mobile.host.notificationsBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this app.
mobile.journeys.label: Journey
mobile.lock.forgot: Forgot it? Clearing the app's storage in Android settings removes the PIN, and every journey on this phone with it.
mobile.lock.heading: Enter your PIN
mobile.lock.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
mobile.meetings.heading: Meetings
mobile.meetings.intro: Many AA, NA and other fellowships publish their meeting lists as a Meeting Guide (code4recovery) feed — ask your local intergroup for the JSON address. The list and your stars stay on this phone.
mobile.meetings.notAFeed: That doesn't look like a meeting feed (expected a JSON list).
mobile.meetings.summary: {count, plural, one {# meeting} other {# meetings}} · updated {date}
mobile.meetings.title: {time} · {name}
mobile.notifications.androidOnly: Notifications are available in the Android app.
mobile.notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for Quit Journey in Android settings, then try again.
mobile.notifications.enable: Send me milestone alerts and reminders
mobile.notifications.heading: Notifications
mobile.notifications.intro: Get a heads-up when you reach a recovery milestone, a daily check-in reminder, and a warning before your riskiest time of the week — for every journey.
mobile.privacy.heading: Privacy
mobile.privacy.iconDisguised: When you leave the app, its home-screen icon changes to "Notes". Android closes the app once to apply it.
mobile.privacy.iconRestored: When you leave the app, the Quit Journey icon comes back.
mobile.privacy.intro: Keep your journey to yourself on a shared or borrowed phone.
mobile.privacy.saved: PIN saved. The app asks for it on launch and after a minute away.
mobile.screenTime.heading: Screen time
mobile.screenTime.intro: For gaming or social-media journeys: count today's minutes in the apps you pick. Android needs "usage access" for this; the numbers never leave your phone.
mobile.screenTime.summary: {count, plural, one {# app counted} other {# apps counted}} · {minutes, plural, one {# min today} other {# min today}}

notify.safety.title: Safety check
plan.aids.heading: Quit aids
plan.aids.intro: Medication and support make a real difference: nicotine replacement, methadone or buprenorphine for opioids, naltrexone or acamprosate for alcohol, therapy and support groups for everything. Log each use or meeting to keep track.
plan.aids.usesLogged: {uses, plural, one {# use logged} other {# uses logged}}
plan.form.error.basic: Enter a start date, how many {unit} a day (above 0) and what it costs (0 if free).
plan.form.error.limit: Set a daily limit above 0 and below your current {unitsPerDay} {unit} a day.
plan.form.reductionIntro: Cutting down is a real goal, not a failure. Days at or under your limit count as wins; use the Today screen to log what you use.
plan.form.startDate: Start date and time (past or future)
plan.form.taperNote: With this substance, a doctor-guided taper is the safest way to come down.
plan.heading: Quit plan
plan.name.heading: Your name
plan.reasons.empty: Add the first one: who or what are you doing this for?
plan.reasons.heading: My reasons to quit
plan.reasons.intro: These show up in the SOS screen when a craving hits.
plan.reasons.placeholder: To run with my kids without getting out of breath
plan.restart.heading: Start over
plan.restart.intro: Back to using regularly? Most people need several attempts — each one teaches you something. Your past attempts and savings stay in your history.
plan.slips.empty: No slips. Keep it that way, one craving at a time.
plan.slips.heading: Slips
plan.slips.intro: A slip keeps your quit date. It only adjusts your savings and restarts the health clock.
plan.support.heading: Support network
plan.support.name: Name

rewards.goal.daysLeft: About {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}} on track.
rewards.goals.empty: Pick a treat — a dinner out, new trainers, a weekend away. Watching it fill up is strangely addictive.
rewards.goals.heading: Save up for something
rewards.jar.heading: In your savings jar
safety.riskyPlace.noPlan: This is one of your risky places. Keep moving, call someone, or open SOS.
safety.timer.androidAlarmNote: The first time, Android asks you to allow "Alarms & reminders" so the alarm rings on the minute.
safety.timer.heading: Check on me
safety.timer.hotlinesIntro: Better: a person on the line.
safety.timer.intro: If you're going to use, don't use alone. Start a timer: if you don't tap "I'm OK" in time, your phone alarms loudly so someone nearby can help, and you can message your contact with one tap. The app can't call anyone by itself.
safety.timer.lateWarning: Your phone may ring this alarm a few minutes late. Allow "Alarms & reminders" for this app in Android settings so it rings on time.
safety.timer.overdueHelp: Tap "I'm OK" to stop the alarm. If someone is with you and you can't be woken, they should call emergency services and give naloxone.
safety.timer.smsBody: I started a safety check in my recovery app and didn't respond. Please check on me now.{hasLocation, select, yes { I'm at: {location}} other {}}
sos.heading: Ride it out
sos.madeIt: You made it through. That's a win.
sos.moneyKept: You've kept {amount} so far. Don't hand it back.
surf.after.label: And now?
surf.before.label: How strong is the urge right now?
surf.dropped: It dropped from {before} to {after}. You rode the wave.
surf.step.board: Stay on the board. Describe it to yourself: tight, warm, buzzing, heavy?
surf.step.breathe: Breathe slowly into that place. You don't have to act on it or fight it.
surf.step.notice: Notice where you feel the urge in your body — chest, throat, hands, stomach. Just notice.
surf.step.passing: Notice how it's changed since you started. Waves pass — this one is passing.
surf.step.wave: Picture the urge as a wave. Watch it rise. Every wave peaks and falls.
surf.trigger.label: What set it off?
today.checkin.done: Done for today. Come back tomorrow to keep the streak going.
today.checkin.heading: Daily check-in
today.headsUp.heading: Heads-up
today.headsUp.riskWindow: Your cravings cluster on {weekday} between {start}:00 and {end}:00. Plan something for that window.
today.ledger.projection: At this pace you'll keep {amount} a year.
today.level.heading: {icon} {name}, level {level}
today.level.toNext: {xp} XP to the next level. Every day on track is worth 100.
today.limit.heading: Today's limit
today.limit.over: Over the limit today. Tomorrow is a fresh day — no streak math can take away what you've already cut.
today.limit.remaining: {remaining} {remainingCount, plural, one {{unitOne}} other {{unit}}} left within today's limit. Best run so far: {best, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
today.prep.heading: Getting ready
today.prep.taper: Cut down gently: aim for no more than {target} {unit} today. You're {percent}% prepared.
today.setup.heading: Your plan
today.setup.intro: Tell us what you're leaving behind, how much you used and what it cost. Everything else — savings, recovery, badges — is calculated from this.
toolkit.drinks.heading: Drink diary
toolkit.drinks.intro: Logging each drink is one of the best-supported ways to cut down. Counted in standard drinks of {grams} g alcohol.
toolkit.drinks.introDefault: Logging each drink is one of the best-supported ways to cut down. Counted in standard drinks of {grams} g alcohol (WHO; change your country under My plan).
toolkit.drinks.week: Last 7 days: {drinks} standard drinks on {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({grams} g alcohol).
toolkit.drugChecks.expectedLabel: What was it supposed to be?
toolkit.drugChecks.heading: Drug checking
toolkit.drugChecks.intro: Testing tells you more, not everything: a negative strip doesn't mean a drug is safe. Log what you found and what you did — it helps you see your own safety habits.
toolkit.drugChecks.positiveWarning: Detected. The safest choice is not to use it. If you do: use much less, go slow, never alone, naloxone ready.
toolkit.gambling.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
toolkit.gambling.daysLeftRenew: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}} — renew it before it lapses
toolkit.gambling.heading: Protection kit
toolkit.gambling.intro: Make gambling hard to reach on your worst day: self-exclude, block, and let your bank stop gambling payments. Most blocks have a cooling-off delay before they can be lifted — that's the point.
toolkit.gambling.lossesTotal: Seeing the real number helps. Logged so far: {total}.
toolkit.medication.copyExactly: Copy the schedule exactly as your clinician or the leaflet gives it. Quit Journey only reminds you — it never suggests doses.
toolkit.medication.empty: Add the medication or aid you use under My plan → Quit aids, then set its schedule here.
toolkit.medication.heading: Medication schedule
toolkit.medication.invalidSchedule: Start with day 1, keep days in increasing order, and give every step a dose and how many times a day.
toolkit.medication.missedDose: If you miss a dose or feel withdrawal during a dose change, don't double up — call your prescriber or pharmacist.
toolkit.medication.overLogged: More doses logged than picked up — check your count with your clinic. Store take-homes locked and out of reach of children.
toolkit.medication.takeHomeLeft: {count, plural, one {# take-home dose} other {# take-home doses}} left.
toolkit.naloxone.empty: No naloxone logged. Pharmacies and harm-reduction services often give it out free.
toolkit.naloxone.heading: Naloxone
toolkit.naloxone.intro: Naloxone (Narcan) reverses an opioid overdose. Keep it where you and the people around you can find it, and replace it when it expires or after use.
toolkit.places.androidOnly: Location alerts are available in the Android app.
toolkit.places.heading: Risky places
toolkit.places.intro: Save places that pull you back — a bar, a dealer's street, the casino. When you open the app near one, it shows your if-then plan. Locations never leave this phone.
toolkit.places.noLocation: Couldn't get your location. Allow location for Quit Journey and try again outside.
toolkit.places.saved: Saved. When you open the app near here, it shows your plan.
toolkit.plans.empty: No plans yet. Start with your most common trigger.
toolkit.plans.heading: If-then plans
toolkit.plans.ifPlaceholder: I'm walking past the bar after work
toolkit.plans.intro: Decide now what you'll do when a trigger hits. Plans pop up when you log a craving with that trigger. They work best when you refresh them every couple of weeks.
toolkit.plans.reviewDue: Time for a quick review — does this still fit?
toolkit.plans.thenPlaceholder: call Anna and keep walking to the gym
toolkit.programs.caughtUp: All caught up — the next mission unlocks tomorrow.
toolkit.programs.finishedBefore: {count, plural, one {# program} other {# programs}} completed or stopped before.
toolkit.programs.heading: Programs
toolkit.scales.empty: No scales for this journey yet.
toolkit.scales.englishOnly: This questionnaire is shown in English because a validated translation isn't available yet.
toolkit.scales.heading: Check-ins & scales
toolkit.scales.intro: Short, validated questionnaires. Retaking them shows your progress over time — they're information for you, not a diagnosis.
toolkit.scales.redFlag: Your last answers point to severe symptoms. Contact your doctor or prescriber today, or emergency services if you feel unsafe.
toolkit.screenTime.grantAccess: Grant usage access and pick your apps in Settings → Screen time first.
toolkit.screenTime.heading: Screen time
toolkit.screenTime.intro: Your old average was about {duration} a day. Track today's time to watch it come down.
toolkit.support.addPartner: Add your partner under My plan → Support network.
toolkit.support.heading: People who can help
toolkit.support.shareIntro: Sends your streak, check-ins and cravings beaten — never your slips or notes.

toolkit.support.summary.sinceStart: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} since I started

toolkit.support.summary.withinLimit: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} within my limit ({within}/{tracked} on track)
toolkit.tab.heading: Your toolkit
toolkit.today.dose.heading: Today's dose
toolkit.today.exclusionEnding: 🛡️ A gambling block ends in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Renew it before it lapses.
toolkit.today.ladder.explainer: Each day without using is worth more than the last; a slip resets the value, and three good days bring it back. Ask a supporter to turn points into real rewards.
toolkit.today.ladder.heading: Reward ladder
toolkit.today.ladder.rebuilding: Rebuilding: {days, plural, one {# more day without using} other {# more days without using}} restores your old level.
toolkit.today.ladder.streak: Day {day} of your streak. Tomorrow is worth {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.
toolkit.today.mission.heading: Today's mission
toolkit.today.naloxoneWarning: 🩹 {count, plural, one {A naloxone kit needs} other {# naloxone kits need}} replacing or renewing soon — see Toolkit.
toolkit.today.redFlag.body: Please contact your doctor or prescriber today. If you have a seizure, confusion, hallucinations or chest pain, call emergency services now.
toolkit.today.redFlag.heading: ⚠️ Severe symptoms on your last {assessment}
